title: It Depends, and What Would Have Been
label: ch:ur-it-depends-and-what-would-have-been
canDo: I can say what something depends on (yih mausam par munhasir hai), say what would be or would have been (agar vaqt hotā, to maiṅ ātā), and tell a short story in six written lines.

payoff.summary: Complete UR-R275-depends-and-would: say what something depends on, and what would have been.
